verdict.rationale: The skills install as ordinary, editable files in your own repo under an MIT license, so there is nothing locked away to export (docs-24, docs-47, docs-42). The artifacts they produce stay in open formats: ADRs, CONTEXT.md, and optionally local markdown issues (gh-2, gh-5, docs-57). Because the skills work with any agent or model, leaving one tool for another is straightforward (gh-12, docs-49). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of exit or portability, no independent hands-on confirmation, and issues kept in GitHub or Linear depend on those services' own export options.
